strings.subtitle: — Jeļā peij —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ejjelok iten im kōm̧m̧an. Kōjerbal bok in lal̗o.
strings.shred_button: K A J E Ļ Ā
strings.ssd_warning:
Kōjatdikdik! Ioon SSD, ejjelok kōm̧m̧an kein jeļā kin TRIM.
Peij in ej ñan HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Peij eo "{name}" enaaj jerrā im kōm̧m̧an.

Etal?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  PEIJ EO AR JERRĀ IM AR KŌM̧M̧AN
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS ial in melele (ADS) ejjelok jerbal.
• USN bok ejjelok kōm̧m̧an.
• Pija kopi im ao sync
  (OneDrive im bar) ejjelok kōm̧m̧an.
strings.status_full: Melele ko ar jerrā ñan jiro aolep. Ejjelok kōm̧m̧an — kein lo pija jiro wōt.
strings.status_fast: Bōran, jikin im 4 MB iaļ ar jerrā. To eo ejjelok kōm̧m̧an, ak kin jikin, jab kōm̧m̧an kein lo pija otemjeļo̧k. Ñan bok in letok, kōjerbal IAAR KŌM̧M̧AN.
strings.status_empty: Peij eo ear ijjelo̧k, jerrā ioon ejjelok aikuj. Ar kōm̧m̧an.
strings.error_permission: Ejjelok alen peij eo. Ear uwak pija ilo bar porokram. Kōm̧m̧an im bar lale.
strings.error_not_found: Ejjelok peij eo ar loe. Ear kōm̧m̧an yokwe.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iien in ej ial in men̄e. Ial kein ejjelok kōm̧m̧an — peij eo ejjan̄in ej naaj pād wōt.
strings.error_reparse: Iien in ej peij in jikin (OneDrive ak bar). Melele ko an ej ilo ao, jab ilo disk — ejjelok melele eo ñan kōm̧m̧an ie.
strings.error_not_file: Iien in ej jab peij (wōt ak bar). Iten peij.
strings.error_hardlinks: Peij in eo ej tōl ikijien (ial aidik) eo ar ({n} otemjeļo̧k). Ial aidik eo ejjelok ejjaan — aolep etan ok. Ñe kōm̧m̧an iien in, melele enaaj jerrā im kadikļo̧k ñan 32 byte, ak to eo enaaj pād ilo ial aidik bar. Kōm̧m̧an aolep ial m̧okta.
strings.error_compressed:
Peij eo ar koba, ar huna ak ar pād. Jerrā ñan jiro ejjelok kōm̧m̧an in melele ko m̧okta kin NTFS ej bōk bar wōt.

Kōm̧m̧an āt: jibwil eo → Āt ko → Ettōr → kōm̧m̧an "Koba" im/ak "Huna". Lale bar SHREDDER.
